channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Captain warns ‘no ship will be a hero’ by risking Hormuz transit
item.description: Captain Raman Kapoor says no vessel will attempt to exit the Strait of Hormuz without assurance of safety.

item.title: US releases Touska container ship crew: Why it matters
item.description: Pakistan said the release of the crew members reflected a 'confidence-building measure' between Tehran and Washington.

item.title: US official says China is ‘funding’ Iran, urges Beijing to help open Hormuz
item.description: Scott Bessent says US has 'absolute control' of Hormuz, but calls on China to 'step up' with diplomacy to reopen strait.

item.title: UAE reports missile and drone strikes incoming from Iran
item.description: No immediate reports of casualties and no immediate comment from ‌Iran.

item.title: Does Trump hold ‘all the cards’ against Iran in the Strait of Hormuz?
item.description: Trump signals confidence in Iran standoff as tensions rise in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Russian strikes kill at least eight in Ukraine, drones hit Moscow
item.description: Kharkiv and Kherson targeted by missiles, while Russian capital suffers rare hit from drones.

item.title: What is hantavirus, suspected in deaths of three people on cruise ship?
item.description: World Health Organization says risk to the general public remains low despite suspected outbreak on the MV Hondius.

item.title: War preparations under way in Iran as Hormuz tensions with US escalate
item.description: Amid stalled talks and sparring over key waterway, Iranian media say US warship struck, but Washington denies incident.

item.title: Two killed and many injured after car driven into crowd in German city of Leipzig
item.description: Mayor Burkhard Jung said a suspect was detained and the motive was unclear.
